title: Lumora serum
text: A clean skincare ad built around a single drop that ends on the bottle
idea: One drop, one face, one bottle. The ad keeps to a cool, clean palette and a single message, then lands on the product and its line: “One Drop. A Fresh Perspective.”
why: One idea per ad: a single drop, never a list of claims.
A calm, clinical palette that says skincare before any words appear.
It ends on the bottle, so the last thing people see is what to buy.
